review.en: Taeko Ohnuki's second solo album, made with Ryuichi Sakamoto at the arranging desk and the American drummer Chris Parker among the players. Its cool jazz-fusion settings and her plain, unhurried writing made little noise at the time. Decades later it was reissued and passed around as a model of what is now called city pop, a quiet record that found its audience late.
review.zh: 大贯妙子的第二张个人专辑，坂本龙一担任编曲，美国鼓手克里斯·帕克参与演奏。冷静的爵士融合编配，加上她朴素从容的写法，当年并没有掀起多少声响。几十年后再版流传，被当作如今所说的“城市流行”的范本，是一张晚到才遇见听众的安静唱片。
